justification: Changes what the served flood planning answer tests (point -> whole lot) on three live surfaces. Not Critical: the lot outline is only used when it contains the point, and it can only add a yes or keep not-known. Not Minor: changes served flood answers.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if the flood check drops the lot outline, if a partial-council point beside a line says 'not held', or if a whole-lot clear lot outside a partial study area becomes no.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live DB 2026-10-29 on a real cadastre lot in Cessnock (fixture): 44.7 m2 of 809.5 m2 inside the 1% AEP extent; point-only answer not known (5.9 m), with the lot yes.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Live /pipeline/flood-planning for that point returned 'we do not hold this council's flood planning map for this area'; the lead was emailed a 'none' result.

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays flood rows for 75 councils; Cessnock PARTIAL 1%AEP; _trusted_lot already requires the outline to contain the point.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The one-answer PRs supported lot_wkt but no website caller sent it.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new source; an existing parameter is now used by every caller.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A malformed or non-containing outline is ignored (point rule); an unknown coordinate system gives null and the point rule.

functions.name: lotRingsToWgs84Wkt
functions.what: Lot rings to a WGS84 POLYGON WKT.
functions.input: ESRI rings and their coordinate system id
functions.output: WKT text, or null when it cannot be trusted
functions.if_none: null rings give null, so only the point is tested
functions.edge_cases: open rings closed; unknown wkid null
functions.failure_mode: Null falls back to the point answer

functions.name: _flood_planning_core
functions.what: Partial-council point beside a line says near, not not-held.
functions.input: point, database connection and optional lot
functions.output: the one flood planning answer with its reason
functions.if_none: no line within 200 m keeps the not-held reason
functions.edge_cases: with a lot the distance query is skipped
functions.failure_mode: Can only change one not-known reason to another not-known reason

break_it.scenario: Lot point 6 m outside a partial council flood line
break_it.what_happens: With the lot it is yes; point only it says near the map
break_it.how: lot_wkt passed by all callers; _nearest_yes_m on partial path

break_it.scenario: Caller sends a neighbouring or stale lot outline
break_it.what_happens: Outline ignored and only the point rule is applied

break_it.scenario: Lot boundary in an unexpected coordinate system
break_it.what_happens: Helper returns null and the point rule is used
